description: Run multiple tool calls in one request. Pass an array of {name, arguments}; returns an array of {success, result} or {success, error} in the same order. Max 200 calls. compact=true returns only { ok, failed, results: [{tool, success, id} | {tool, success:false, error}] } — use it for bulk writes where you do not need the records back.

calls.description: Tool calls to run in order, max 200

name.description: Name of the tool to call

compact.description: Return only ok/failed counts and per-call ids instead of full results

name: batch_tools
